Un récord más: Bodhana Sivanandan supera una marca establecida por Judit Polgar hace 38 años
rubriker._rss_content: La Federación Inglesa de Ajedrez la calificó de «talento generacional». Bodhana Sivanandan, de 11 años, batió otro récord mundial al convertirse en la jugadora más joven de la historia en cumplir los requisitos para obtener el título de Maestro Internacional (MI). De este modo, superó una marca establecida hace 38 años por la legendaria Judit Polgar, considerada ampliamente como la mejor ajedrecista de todos los tiempos. | Foto: Rafal Oleksiewicz

rubriker.title: KazChess Masters Almaty 2026 - Live!
rubriker._rss_content: The KazChess Masters Almaty 2026 takes place from 26 October to 3 November in Kazakhstan. The ten-player invitational tournament brings together five international grandmasters and five players from the host country. Among the best-known participants are Muhammad Muradli, Daniil Dubov and Denis Lazavik, who recently reached the Esports World Cup final. Another player to watch is 14-year-old Kazakh talent Mark Smirnov (pictured). | Live from approximately 6:15 AM ET / 3:45 PM IST / 11:15 AM CET | Photo: Kazakhstan Chess Federation

rubriker.title: Svitlana's Smart Moves - King’s Indian Attack at the Olympiad
rubriker._rss_content: In this special Olympiad episode of Svitlana’s Smart Moves, Svitlana looks back at her final round game for Canada against Singapore. She explains how she handled a familiar setup in the King's Indian Attack, why she chose a safer practical route instead of an early pawn sacrifice, and how typical plans such as e5 and kingside pressure developed into a strong attack. She features several instructive tactical moments, difficult decisions about when to simplify, and a winning endgame that Svitlana had to calculate precisely.

rubriker.title: Timur Turlov outlines plans to restructure FIDE
rubriker._rss_content: FIDE President Timur Turlov has presented plans for a new organizational structure aimed at clarifying responsibilities, improving governance and strengthening the federation's international activities. The proposed changes include a stronger role for the FIDE Council, a new Advisory Board and several leadership appointments. Turlov also outlined plans to expand support for national federations, chess education and international partnerships.

rubriker.title: European Club Cup: Amateurs rub shoulders with the pros
rubriker._rss_content: While looking through the standings of the European Club Cup which concluded last week, René Mandelbaum focused on the teams at the bottom of the table. To his surprise, he discovered that many of their players were rated between 1800 and 2000. These are good club players - still, he had expected stronger opposition at a European championship. "With a field like this, we shouldn't finish last", he thought. | Photos: SK Weisse Dame Hamburg

rubriker.title: Harvey beats Willow in Armageddon, claims English Rapidplay title
rubriker._rss_content: IM Marcus Harvey won the English Rapidplay Championship in Peterborough after defeating fellow IM Jonah Willow in a five-game playoff. Both players finished the 11-round tournament on 9 points, half a point ahead of top seed Michael Adams, who was held to a draw in the final round. Harvey and Willow exchanged wins in both the rapid and blitz stages of the playoff before Harvey prevailed in Armageddon. | Photo: Yuri Krylov / 4NCL

rubriker.title: KCF Academy: Third Season Highlights
rubriker._rss_content: The Kasparov Chess Foundation Academy has wrapped up its third season, marking another important year of growth for the organization, with expanding educational programs, international events, and outstanding achievements by participants in KCF programs. And the momentum isn't slowing down: registration is now open for the KCF Academy 2027 season, a six-month online training program for ambitious chess players around the world.

FIDE Calls an Online Extraordinary General Assembly
rubriker._rss_content: Timur Turlov said earlier this year that FIDE would hold another General Assembly before 2026 ended, and he has now put a date on it. In an invitation published on October 26, FIDE announced an Extraordinary General Assembly for December 27 at 14:30 CET, held online.

rubriker.title: Game of the Day: GM Artem Uskov Beats IM Sanjin Culum
rubriker._rss_content: GM Artem Uskov beat IM Sanjin Culum in round 2, board 7 of the 2026 Serbian Second League group Voivodina, winning in 31 moves.

rubriker.title: Bayegan Pendik y Monte-Carlo se quedan con el oro en la Copa Europea de Clubes
rubriker._rss_content: Bayegan Pendik y Cercle d'Echecs de Monte-Carlo conquistaron los títulos de la Copa Europea de Clubes en Budva. Ambos equipos terminaron igualados en puntos con sus rivales más cercanos y se impusieron gracias a los criterios de desempate. Novy Bor terminó segundo en la sección abierta, mientras que Gambit Bonnevoie obtuvo la medalla de plata en la competición femenina. Por su parte, Bodhana Sivanandan, de 11 años, consiguió su última norma de MI y se convirtió en la jugadora más joven de la historia en cumplir los requisitos para obtener el título. | Foto: Gerd Densing
